name: contribution_links
description: A link a community publishes so members can claim a contribution themselves, within a cycle and a cap. Redeeming one writes a contributions row that points back here.

columns.name: memo
columns.description: Becomes the memo of every contribution claimed through this link.

columns.name: code
columns.description: The code carried in the published link. Unlike a transaction link this one is meant to be handed out widely — it is not a bearer secret.

columns.name: cycle
columns.description: How often the same member may claim it.

columns.name: total_max_count_of_contribution
columns.description: Cap across all members, not per member. NULL means uncapped.

columns.name: max_account_balance_gdd4
columns.description: Refuse the claim if the member's balance is already above this. NULL means no such check.

columns.name: min_gap_hours
columns.description: Minimum distance between two claims by the same member, on top of the cycle.

columns.name: link_enabled
columns.description: An admin switch that is independent of the validity window. Disabled inside the window is a normal state.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.description: Soft delete. The contributions that were claimed through the link keep pointing at it.

notes: Whether a claim is allowed is decided by five independent limits — cycle, max_per_cycle, max_amount_per_month_gdd4, total_max_count_of_contribution, max_account_balance_gdd4, min_gap_hours — plus the validity window and link_enabled. Both implementations must evaluate all of them; passing one is not passing the link. This is the strongest candidate in db/ for a test-vector file.
contributions.contribution_link_id points here but carries no foreign key in legacy, and a soft-deleted link keeps its contributions. Deleting a row outright would orphan them.

Legacy declares created_at, valid_from and valid_to as datetime WITHOUT precision(3) — second precision. min_gap_hours arithmetic on second-precision timestamps is unaffected, but do not rely on sub-second ordering. See types/Timestamp.json.

The three money columns carry the _gdd4 suffix since migration 0100; the entity still exposes them as amount, maxAmountPerMonth and maxAccountBalance. legacyName records the pre-0100 column names for a migration reading an old dump.

open.question: Is code unique?
open.detail: No unique constraint exists in legacy, and the lookup is by code. Two links sharing a code would make the claim path ambiguous.
open.status: unanswered — the same question transaction_links.code raises, and it should be answered the same way for both
